en: This black-and-white postcard is divided into three photographic segments. The top segment depicts a lakeside scene with half-timbered houses, a tall industrial chimney, and a large building in the background, likely a manor or small castle. The lower left segment shows a villa-style residential building with people gathered in front, labeled 'Carl Zimmermann' on the facade. The lower right segment features a larger institutional building with a central clock tower, likely a school or municipal facility. The postcard has decorative floral elements in the lower right-hand corner.
